info.title: Oh Ho Bastra API
info.description:
REST API of the Oh Ho Bastra storefront (Express + TypeScript).

- Auth uses HTTP-only cookies; browsers must send credentials.
- Request and response bodies are snake_case JSON.
- Money is always an integer amount in cents.
- Every response has `success` and `message`. Failures add a machine-readable `code`, and validation failures list `errors` with a react-hook-form style `field` path.
- Every response carries an `X-Request-ID` header (a valid incoming one is reused).

get.description: Where Google sends the browser back. Checks the state against the `google_oauth` cookie, trades the code for the Google profile and signs in the customer linked to that Google account, creating one for a new email. Sets the `access_token` and `refresh_token` (HTTP-only) cookies and the readable `is_logged_in` cookie. Then redirects to `?next=` from the start (else the home page, or /admin for an admin). Any failure redirects to the login page with `?google_error=` set to `cancelled`, `failed`, `unverified` (the Google email isn't verified) or `exists` (a password account already uses the email).
